title: Jamaican Chicken Skewers with Zesty Dipping Sauce
description: A fusion of Japanese and Jamaican flavors, these chicken skewers are marinated in a sweet and spicy mixture, grilled to perfection and served with a zesty dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: Zesty soy sauce
ingredients.notes: or regular soy sauce with a squeeze of fresh lime juice

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together zesty soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, green onions, grated ginger, and Jamaican jerk seasoning.
Add the chicken cubes to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated chicken cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve the skewers hot with additional zesty dipping sauce on the side, if desired.
